prompt_text: I need a personal injury lawyer in Atlanta after a car accident. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Atlanta for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
Below are five Atlanta-area personal injury firms you should call after a car accident, with a short reason to contact each. I picked firms known for representing accident victims in Georgia (size, resources, trial experience, local reputation). Call several to compare style, experience, and fee terms.

Specific firms to call (and why)
- Morgan & Morgan (Atlanta) — One of the largest plaintiff-side firms in the U.S.; lots of resources to handle medical liens, extensive investigator/medical networks, and experience with high-value/car-accident cases.
- The Cochran Firm Atlanta — Longstanding national plaintiff firm with an Atlanta office; known for wrongful death and serious injury work and trial experience against insurers.
- Slappey & Sadd (Atlanta) — Local Atlanta firm that focuses heavily on car accidents and catastrophic injury claims; established regional reputation and familiarity with local courts.
- John Foy & Associates — Atlanta-based trial-focused personal injury firm well known locally for motor vehicle accident representation and client advocacy.
- Harris Lowry Manton LLP — Georgia firm that handles catastrophic injury and wrongful death claims, with medical expertise and experience taking cases to trial when needed.

What to expect and why call multiple firms
- Free initial consultation: most plaintiff firms will evaluate your case free and on contingency (they get paid only if you recover).
- Different firms bring different strengths: national firms often have more resources for big cases; local boutique firms can offer more personalized attention and deep local court knowledge.
- Calling 3–4 firms lets you compare communication, strategy, and how comfortable you feel with the attorney.

Important practical tips for those calls
- Statute of limitations: in Georgia, the general personal injury deadline is 2 years from the accident date (there are exceptions). Call promptly to protect your rights.
- Bring/describe: police report, photos, contact info for other drivers/witnesses, medical records or bills, insurance info, and any employer/time-off records.
- Key questions to ask on first call:
  - Do you handle car-accident/personal injury cases in Atlanta/this county?
  - Have you handled cases like mine (fact pattern/severity)? What were the outcomes?
  - Will you take the case on contingency? What is your fee and how are expenses handled?
  - Do you have trial experience in cases that didn’t settle?
  - Who will be my main contact, and how often will I get updates?
  - What is the expected timeline and next steps?
- Watch for red flags: promises of guaranteed results, poor communication, or pressure to sign without clear fee terms.

If you want, I can:
- Draft a short phone script and checklist of documents to bring for each firm.
- Help you prioritize which of the above firms to call first if you tell me: county where the accident happened, date of accident, and severity of injuries.
